x-e-m1-01.title: Ben 会来参加派对吗？推敲回答的言外之意
x-e-m1-01.goal: 把对话中 Ben 的回答一句一句拆开，分辨已经解决的和还剩下的，不武断地说“会来/不会来”，而是做出判断。
x-e-m1-01.material:
Jisu 和 Ben 的对话（没有图片，只用文字写成）：

Jisu: Do you want to come to my birthday party on Saturday?
Ben: Saturday? Hmm. I have a soccer game in the morning.
Jisu: The party is at 4 p.m.
Ben: Oh, that might work. I'll probably be tired, though.
Jisu: So... are you coming?
Ben: Let me check with my mom first.

x-e-m1-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: 这是同时用了聚会约定和票价昂贵两条线索的判断。
